## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` and the relevant package tests pass
- [ ] New behavior has tests
- [ ] No secrets committed (CI runs a gitleaks scan)
- [ ] Docs / env templates updated if behavior or config changed
- [ ] UI changes are visually neutral unless the change *is* the visuals (call those out)
